study.title: Modular Transformer Architecture for Precision Agriculture Imaging
study.short_title: Modular quality-aware ViT weed segmentation (sorghum); Dice 0.85

segmentation.domain: weed segmentation from drone imagery (sorghum field) under noise and motion blur, using a quality-aware modular ViT framework that routes frames to clean/denoise/deblur (or combined) processing based on Laplacian and MAD thresholds
models_tested: ViT + FV + LR applied to all images
segmentation.best_model: ViT+FV+LR (both modules applied to all frames): Dice 0.8512; modular-routing variant 0.8492 at 11 min training

dataset.name: Sorghum dataset (Genze et al. 2023, DeBlurWeedSeg) - 1,300 non-overlapping blurred-sharp UAV image pairs
dataset.note: Drone-acquired images over a sorghum field: 1,300 blurred-sharp pairs with labeled segmentation masks (each file holds blurred, deblurred, sharp and ground-truth quadrants). 80% training / 20% validation partition. Frames contain drone-motion blur and particulate noise.

segmentation.backbone: Vision transformer encoder (patch embedding + MSA/MLP blocks); Fisher Vector (GMM-based) encoding replacing noisy patches in the encoder for denoising; unrolled Lucy-Richardson deconvolution with PSF-as-query attention in the decoder for deblurring; quality-aware router

mIoU.ambiguity: Only Dice-Score (Sorenson-Dice) reported (matching Genze et al. metric).

F1.ambiguity: F1 not reported; equivalent to Dice for a binary segmentation but not separately stated.

Dice.quote: Column 5 presents the results obtained by combining both the de-noise and de-blur modules. Notably, this combination achieves the highest Dice-Score of all the tested combinations, reaching 0.8512.
Dice.ambiguity: Best Dice 0.8512 (ViT+FV+LR applied to ALL images). Routing variant scores 0.8492 with far lower training time (11 vs 50 min). Genze et al. baseline 0.8373; vanilla ViT 0.7794. Note training-time columns are inconsistent between Tables I/II (ViT 3.5 vs 10.5 min).

edge.framework: PyTorch, Python 3.12.10, scikit-learn, scikit-image; Apple M4 Pro (24 GB, 10-core GPU); only training time reported (e.g. 11 min routing variant vs 50 min always-on FV+LR)

latency_ms.ambiguity: Computational-efficiency claims are about training time only; inference latency not reported.

issues: No inference-speed or edge-deployment metrics; efficiency evaluated via training time on an Apple M4 Pro (inconsistent 3.5 vs 10.5 min figures across Table I/II).
Dice-based evaluation only (metric matched to Genze et al. baseline); no mIoU/PA per-class metrics.
Dataset reused from Genze et al. 2023 (1,300 blurred-sharp pairs); split 80/20; no new UAV acquisition details (GSD/altitude not stated).
Best Dice requires unconditional FV+LR processing (50 min training); the routing variant trades 0.2 pp Dice for 4.5x training speed.
